title: T7 — Project Brief
body:
# Project brief

## Outcome

The conveyor operates the estate: an incident is opened, triaged, mitigated by an approved write,
resolved with a postmortem; a destructive call without the tenant's approvals is refused.

## Boundary

Not in scope: the process engine (S13) and the procedure catalogue (T18); the k8s API is reached
only through a registered host and read-only actions for reads.

## Reuse sources

The action spine's approvals and governed assets, the cards/board surfaces, T4's contracts, and
T5's systemic-improvement loop.

## Inception units

The ops actions (`ops.incident`, triage, the write verbs), the approval policy, and the host
registry.

## Dependencies

T2 and T4; T5 for the systemic loop; the cluster live proof is deploy-bound.

## Acceptance

SPEC_V2 §12 T7, proven by the executed suite and `acceptance/programme/T7.toml`.

## Capabilities

An operator can run an incident through the product's own actions, with the tenant's policy as
the only path to a destructive write.

## Plan

Delivered in tranche 5; the tranche-5 PI plan carries the objectives and capacity.

## Risks

The live proof needs the deployed operator CLI; a host must be registered before a live read; the
systemic loop's kata is T5's.
